turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
You probably talk about last weekend or yesterday in your own language, too. In English, the verb changes. Look: Every day I walk to work. Last Monday I walked to work. The walk is finished, so I add -ed: "walked".
The rule: for many verbs, add -ed when the action is finished in the past.
Right: Two days ago we cleaned the car. Wrong: Two days ago we clean the car.
Your turn. Write the past form: Last night my sister ___ (cook) pasta.
